english.title: Knowingly / recklessly furnishes false document / information to obtain / procure UK plant passport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 41(b) and 48 of the Official Controls (Plant Health and Genetically Modified Organisms) (England) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
knowingly / recklessly furnished
a document / information which was false in a material particular
for the purposes of obtaining an authorisation for a UK plant passport / certificate OR
for the purposes of obtaining a permit for a UK plant passport / certificate OR
for the purposes of procuring the issue of a UK plant passport or certificate

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where an offence under these Regulations is proved to have been committed with the consent or connivance of an officer, or to be attributable to any neglect on the part of an officer, the officer as well as the body corporate, is guilty of an offence and is liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly.
(ii) "Officer" in relation to a body corporate means a director, manager, secretary or other similar officer of the body, or a person purporting to act in such capacity.
(iii) Where an offence under these Regulations is committed by a partnership or an unincorporated association bringing proceedings against the partnership or association in the name of the partnership or association, see regulation 47.
